title: Coordination of Road Works to Minimise Inconvenience to Road Users
what_it_is: Coordination of Road Works to Minimise Inconvenience to Road Users

sections.label: Road works planning and permit fees
sections.summary: The Committee plans road works up to a month ahead, but emergency works like cable faults or gas leaks cannot be forecasted, and LTA announced a new road work permit fee structure.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: While the Committee plans road works as far as one month ahead and as far as possible, some emergency works cannot be forecasted, such as repair of cable faults or gas leaks.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: To further encourage agencies and contractors to more optimally plan their road works, LTA recently announced a new fee structure for road work permits that increases with the time taken for the works, the geographical extent of the works and if the works take place during peak hours.

sections.label: Road opening coordination committee
sections.summary: LTA receives 12,000 or more applications a year, and a committee of agencies coordinates road works months in advance to avoid repeated digging.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: LTA receives 12,000 or more applications a year for such road reconstruction or digging up for different purposes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: The Committee that meets up includes members from agencies like HDB, PUB, NParks, JTC, Singtel, Singapore Power, LTA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: So, it is quite a number of agencies that come together to coordinate and they do it a few months in advance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Where possible, they will make sure that it is not dug up repeatedly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Within a reasonable timeframe, the Road Opening Coordination Committee will optimise the road works.
